sql_templates.template:
WITH latest_stage AS ( 
 SELECT symbol, stage, trading_signal 
 FROM scores.stage_snapshots 
 WHERE snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM scores.stage_snapshots) 
 AND trading_signal IN ('BUY', 'STRONG_BUY')), 
 recent_deals AS ( 
 SELECT DISTINCT symbol, side, deal_date, qty, price 
 FROM signals.bulk_block_deals 
 WHERE deal_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1 month') 
 SELECT i.symbol, i.entity, i.qty, i.value_cr, i.insider_score, 
 b.side, s.stage, s.trading_signal 
 FROM signals.insider_alerts i 
 JOIN latest_stage s ON i.symbol = s.symbol 
 JOIN recent_deals b ON i.symbol = b.symbol 
 WHERE i.alert_date = (SELECT MAX(alert_date) FROM signals.insider_alerts) 
 LIMIT 50;
